output.review_comment: The reordering of minimum and cap logic in the return statement creates an ambiguous edge case: if MINIMUM_FEE_CENTS > cap, the code allows it to exceed the cap, but the comment suggests the cap should always win. This contradicts the original logic min(max(fee, MINIMUM_FEE_CENTS), cap). The changes to ceiling division and rounding appear intentional and likely correct, but the min/cap/max logic needs clarification against the docstring requirements before merging.
